## Scope

What changed and why?

## Validation

List commands, checks, and anything not validated.

## Agent/project state

Note relevant updates to `task.md`, lessons, session logs, or `projects/<slug>/validation.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I considered whether `task.md`, lessons, or a session log need updating.
- [ ] I did not hand-edit generated files under `corpus/`.
- [ ] If the corpus changed, I regenerated it and measured the complete Gitingest output.
- [ ] If a CAD project changed, I updated its project brief and validation evidence.
- [ ] I checked that no secrets or machine-specific paths were added.
